title: Contentment
definition: Contentment is resting in God's wise provision and faithfulness without being ruled by comparison, greed, fear, or complaint.
summary: Contentment does not deny hardship. It trusts that God is enough and that His grace sustains His people in every season.
christFocus: Christ strengthens believers to live with peace and trust whether they have little or much.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Contentment does not deny hardship. It trusts that God is enough and that His grace sustains His people in every season.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
